title: STD-007: PDF/A conformance reachable from the CLI
acceptance: pdfxi preflight and pdfxi export conformance run on real fixtures with PDF/A-2b and PDF/X-4 profiles, apply the byte-expressible fixups, and never claim certification; STD-007 becomes verified on the cli host with evidence.
notes: ADR 0009 row 3. The CLI validate/convert path exists; only promotion and evidence are missing.
